user.title: Set up Petkit Water Fountain
user.description: Select a discovered Petkit fountain, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Petkit Fountain
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the **{name}** fountain ({address})?

init_device.title: Set up the fountain
init_device.description: Connecting to **{name}** to check whether it is bound to a PetKit account. If the connection fails, bring the fountain or a Bluetooth proxy closer and submit to try again.

confirm_repair.title: Fountain is bound to a PetKit account
confirm_repair.description:
**{name}** is already bound, most likely to the PetKit app, and only answers after its secret is verified. The secret could not be read automatically from the PetKit cloud integration.

**Enter the secret** keeps the app pairing: you can find it in the PetKit cloud integration's device diagnostics (field `secret`).

**Re-pair** writes a new secret to the fountain. This overwrites the existing pairing: the PetKit app and the cloud integration stop reaching the fountain until you factory reset it and bind it again.

menu_options.enter_secret: Enter the existing secret (keeps the app pairing)
menu_options.repair_cancel: Cancel and leave the device untouched

enter_secret.title: Enter the fountain secret
enter_secret.description: Hex secret of **{name}** as shown by the PetKit cloud (12 or 16 hex characters). It is only verified; nothing is written to the fountain.

error.no_devices_found: No Petkit fountains were found nearby. Enter the MAC address manually.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the fountain. Make sure it is in range and that the PetKit app is not connected to it, then try again.
error.device_already_initialized: Device is already initialized. Please factory reset it first (detach control module, hold power button 3 seconds until LEDs flash).
error.init_failed: Failed to initialize the device. Please try again.
error.invalid_secret: That is not a valid secret. Use 2 to 16 hex characters.
error.secret_rejected: The fountain did not accept this secret, or it could not be reached. Bring it into range and check the value.

abort.device_already_initialized: This device is already initialized with a secret. Please factory reset it first (detach control module, hold power button for 3 seconds until LEDs flash), then try again.
abort.repair_failed: Could not re-pair the device. Bring it closer and try again; if it keeps failing, factory reset it (detach control module, hold power button 3 seconds until LEDs flash), then re-add it.
abort.repair_cancelled: Re-pairing cancelled. The device was left untouched.
abort.unsupported_device: This device model may not be fully supported by this integration. Please report this issue on GitHub with your device model and logs.

data_description.debug: Log every BLE frame (TX/RX) and authentication step. Useful for diagnosing connection issues. Disable in production.
data_description.sync_clock: Write Home Assistant's local time to the fountain after each connection (CMD 84). The fountain uses its clock for the "today" counters and schedules. Reading works without it.
